core.codes.pck-directory-refused.title: Content refused
core.codes.pck-directory-refused.message: Some content was refused because it contains files a content pack may not hold.
core.codes.pck-engine-mismatch.title: Content not supported
core.codes.pck-engine-mismatch.message: This content needs a different version of the game. Update the game.
core.codes.pack-rolled-back.title: Content restored
core.codes.pack-rolled-back.message: The last content update didn't start, so the previous version was restored.
core.codes.pack-revoked.title: Content withdrawn
core.codes.pack-revoked.message: This content was withdrawn by its developer and can't be used.
core.codes.pack-not-data-only.title: Content refused
core.codes.pack-not-data-only.message: Some content was refused because it contains files a data pack may not hold.

core.codes.marker-rejected.message: This build's built-in content isn't valid. Reinstall the app or contact the developer.
core.codes.license_required.title: License needed
core.codes.license_required.message: Activate the app, then try again.
core.codes.license_invalid.title: License not accepted
core.codes.license_invalid.message: Your license couldn't be verified. Reconnect the app, then try again.

core.codes.license_stale.message: Connect to the internet so the app can refresh your license, then try again.
core.codes.sign_in_required.title: Sign-in needed
core.codes.sign_in_required.message: Sign in to your Polaris Locker account in the app, then try again.
core.codes.attach-declined.title: Not added
core.codes.attach-declined.message: This license wasn't added to your account. Nothing changed.
core.gate.ok.title: License active
core.gate.grace.title: Offline grace
core.gate.grace.message: The licensing service can't be reached. You can keep using the app until the grace period ends.
core.gate.expired.title: License expired
core.gate.expired.message: Connect to the internet or renew your license to continue.
core.gate.revoked.title: Signed out
core.gate.revoked.message: This device was signed out. Sign in or activate again to continue.
core.gate.needs-activation.title: Activate
core.gate.needs-activation.message: Enter a license key or sign in to continue.
core.gate.version-too-old.title: Update required
core.gate.version-too-old.message: This version is no longer supported. Update {product} to continue.
core.gate.version-too-new.title: Not available on this license
core.gate.version-too-new.message: This build is newer than your license allows.
core.gate.channel-not-entitled.title: Channel not included
core.gate.channel-not-entitled.message: Your license doesn't include this channel.
core.gate.not-applicable.title: No license needed
core.gate.not-applicable.message: This app doesn't need a license.
core.activation.ok.title: Activated
core.activation.ok.message: Your license is active on this device.
core.activation.device-limit.title: Device limit reached
core.activation.device-limit.message: This license is already on all its devices. Replace a device to use it here.
core.activation.fingerprint-required.mes: This license needs a hardware fingerprint, which couldn't be read on this device.
core.activation.hardware-mismatch.title: Device changed
core.activation.hardware-mismatch.messag: This device's hardware changed. Activate again to use your license here.
core.activation.enroll-claimed.title: Sign in to continue
core.activation.enroll-claimed.message: This device's free license belongs to an account now. Sign in to use it.
core.activation.license-disabled.title: License disabled
core.activation.license-disabled.message: This license has been disabled. Contact the developer.
core.activation.license-expired.title: License expired
core.activation.license-expired.message: This license has expired. Renew it to continue.
core.activation.attestation-required.mes: This license needs a verified device. Let the app check this device, then try again.
core.activation.rate-limited.title: Too many attempts
core.activation.rate-limited.message: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
core.activation.unauthorized.title: Key not accepted
core.activation.unauthorized.message: That license key wasn't accepted. Check it and try again.
core.activation.enroll-disabled.title: No free license
core.activation.enroll-disabled.message: This app doesn't offer a free license. Enter a license key or sign in.
core.activation.key-entry-limit.title: No key entries left
core.activation.key-entry-limit.message: Sign in and add this key to your Polaris Locker account instead.
core.activation.license-owned.title: License in another account
core.activation.license-owned.message: Sign in to the Polaris Locker account that has this license to use it.
core.activation.refused.title: Activation refused
core.activation.error.title: Activation failed
core.activation.error.message: Activation didn't finish. Check your connection and try again.
